notes: All 8 searches ran; none were refused. The site-restricted search returned no figures.house.gov pages, so I opened his press release list directly (figures.house.gov/media/press-releases, first two pages, 20 releases dated 2 June to 11 November 2026): none mention AI. A Denver7 result about a congressman studying AI turned out to be about Rep. Don Beyer, not Figures. Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act (H.R. 10538, introduced 24 September 2026 by Rep. Casar): about 9 to 10 House cosponsors, but no source I could open gave the full list (congress.gov returned 403; Quiver Quantitative and Forkast do not list all names; FastDemocracy lists Hoyle, Lynch and Tonko). No source shows Figures as a cosponsor, but this is not fully verified. Older press release pages (before June 2026) were not checked.
